def interleave : List α → List α → List α
  | [], ys => ys
  | x :: xs, ys => x :: interleave ys xs
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length

theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
    (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length := by
  let P : Nat → Prop := fun n => ∀ xs ys, xs.length + ys.length = n →
    (interleave xs ys).length = n
  have hP : ∀ n, P n := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro xs ys hlen
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp [P, interleave] at hlen ⊢
      | cons x xs =>
        cases ys with
        | nil => simp [P, interleave] at hlen ⊢
        | cons y ys =>
          simp only [P, interleave, List.length_cons]
          have hlt : (y :: ys).length + xs.length < n := by simp at hlen; omega
          have hrec := ih ((y :: ys).length + xs.length) hlt (y :: ys) xs rfl
          simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc] using congrArg Nat.succ hrec
  exact hP (xs.length + ys.length) xs ys rfl
